message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round and by collecting cards from opponents’ hands. | | **Players** | 2–10. Each player gets 7 cards at the start. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1‑9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile; if it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn order** | Players play clockwise. The “Reverse” card flips direction. | | **Playing a card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise you keep it and the turn passes to the next player. | | **Action cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player also draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls you out, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a round** | The first player to get rid of all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | The winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Game end** | Play continues until someone reaches the agreed‑upon point total (commonly 500). | **Optional house rules** - *Stacking*: Some groups allow stacking Draw Two/Wild Draw Four cards (e.g., if you’re faced with a Draw Two, you can play another Draw Two to pass the burden). - *No “Wild Draw Four” challenge*: Others forbid challenging a Wild Draw Four, making it a simple “draw four” regardless of whether the player had a matching color. - *“Seven-O” rule*: If a player plays a 7, they can swap hands with anyone else; if a player plays an 0, everyone shuffles their hands together. Feel free to tweak or add house rules to suit your group!
